skill.name: yolo
skill.description: Automates Lovable edge function and migration deployments through Lovable MCP or browser automation, with optional post-deployment verification.
skill.summary: Automate Lovable deployments and verification from Claude workflows.
skill.author: 10K-Digital

security_audit.summary: Static detections are mostly documentation false positives: Markdown backticks, example URLs, and example secret names are not executable code or leaked credentials. Semantic review found real operational risk because the skill can automate Lovable deployments, migration application, and external prompt submission when enabled.

remediation.issue: Auto-deploy can run after git push to main.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before each production deployment or migration, even when auto_deploy is enabled.

remediation.issue: Migration automation can change database state.
remediation.suggestion: Add a preflight summary that lists migration files and requires approval before submitting the Lovable prompt.

remediation.issue: Deployment prompts are sent to Lovable through MCP or browser automation.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users that generated prompts may include project context and are transmitted to Lovable.

content.value_statement: Lovable backend deployments can require repeated manual prompts and checks. This skill automates edge function and migration workflows with MCP or browser automation and reports verification results.
actual_capabilities: Detects yolo mode settings in CLAUDE.md before running deployment workflows.
Uses Lovable MCP send_message when available and browser automation as a fallback.
Generates deployment prompts for Supabase edge functions and migrations.
Can trigger deployment automation after a successful git push when auto-deploy is enabled.
Runs configured verification checks after deployment and summarizes results.
Provides manual fallback prompts when automation fails.
limitations: Requires Lovable MCP access or a working browser automation environment.
Browser mode can break if the Lovable interface changes.
Focused on edge functions and migrations, not all Lovable project operations.
Auto-deploy behavior can affect production workflows if enabled without review.

use_cases.title: Speed up backend iteration
use_cases.description: Deploy changed edge functions from Claude after code is pushed and verify the result.

use_cases.title: Automate migration application
use_cases.description: Submit migration prompts to Lovable and track success or failure with clear fallback steps.

use_cases.title: Standardize deployment checks
use_cases.description: Use repeatable verification levels for logs, console errors, and endpoint behavior after deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Enable yolo mode
prompt_templates.prompt: Enable yolo mode for my Lovable project and explain what configuration you will read before deploying.

prompt_templates.title: Deploy an edge function
prompt_templates.prompt: Use yolo mode to deploy the changed edge function and run the default verification checks.

prompt_templates.title: Apply migrations with verification
prompt_templates.prompt: Use yolo mode to apply the new Supabase migration, then verify that the deployment completed successfully.

prompt_templates.title: Auto-deploy after push
prompt_templates.prompt: After this git push succeeds, detect backend changes and use yolo auto-deploy only if the project configuration allows it.

output_examples.input: Deploy the send-email edge function with yolo mode.
output_examples.output: The skill reports the selected deployment method, sends the Lovable prompt, monitors completion, and lists verification results.

output_examples.input: Apply the new migration after push.
output_examples.output: The skill detects migration files, submits the migration prompt, and provides a success or fallback summary.

output_examples.input: Yolo mode failed to find the chat input.
output_examples.output: The skill explains the browser automation failure and gives a manual prompt to copy into Lovable.

best_practices: Use MCP mode when possible because it is more stable than browser automation.
Keep yolo testing enabled for deployments that affect production behavior.
Review auto-deploy settings before pushing changes to main.
anti_patterns: Do not enable auto-deploy for production changes that require manual approval.
Do not rely on browser automation when Lovable login or UI state is unknown.
Do not skip verification for migrations or edge functions with external dependencies.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It automates Lovable deployment prompts for edge functions and migrations, then can run verification checks.

faq.question: Does it require Lovable MCP?
faq.answer: No. MCP is preferred, but the skill can fall back to browser automation or a manual prompt.

faq.question: Can it deploy automatically after git push?
faq.answer: Yes, but only when yolo mode and auto-deploy are enabled in the project configuration.

faq.question: What does it verify after deployment?
faq.answer: It can check deployment logs, production console errors, and safe functional endpoint tests.

faq.question: Can it manage every Lovable operation?
faq.answer: No. The documented scope is edge functions and migrations, with broader support listed as future work.

faq.question: Is it safe for production deployments?
faq.answer: Use caution. Auto-deploy can affect production systems, so teams should require review for sensitive changes.
